title: Baker Hughes and Mantle Reach Power, an EnCap Energy Transition Company, Announce Strategic Agreement to Accelerate Large-scale Geothermal Across North America
summary: Collaboration aims to remove historical hurdles to scaling geothermal energy, targets installation of up to 500 megawatts of power in the next five years Projects will utilize Baker Hughes’ integrated portfolio of scalable, lower-carbon energy solutions HOUSTON and LONDON, June 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, and Mantle Reach Power, a dedicated geothermal development company backed by EnCap Energy Transition Fund III, announced Wednesday a new commercial agreement to facilitate the economically viable, financially sustainable large-scale deployment of geothermal energy in North America. The agreement underscores the parties’ shared commitment to advance the next generation of clean and reliable baseload power needed to meet the demand driven by electrification and the rapid growth of artificial intelligence and hyperscale computing – which require reliable, around-the-clock energy.
